name_zh: 翻译作为艺术实践与中心—边缘协商
name_en: translation as artistic practice and center-periphery negotiation

definitions.author: Terry Smith
definitions.text: 翻译不只是将意义完整传送到另一语言，而是在语言、制度、地方语境和不平等关系之间进行的转化；艺术家和观众可共同参与这种转化。

source.chapter: The Tasks of Translation: Art & Language in Australia and New Zealand 1975–76
source.location: Benjamin/Derrida discussion; Australian and New Zealand exhibitions
